_comment: The Unknown test. Almost everything in his account is Unknown, and the reason matters:
not because the people were evasive, but because four dates do not contain conflict,
money trouble, a family emergency or anything else that would show how someone behaves
under pressure. The absence of contradictory evidence is not a Pass, and his file has
to make that visible rather than stated.
He is also the inverse of the usual demo: he is the one being quietly assessed in
three other accounts, and his own record shows him doing the same thing back, with
the same honest shortage of information.
I considered inventing a current person for him so the 'few dates' case would be live
rather than historical, and did not — the specification's cast is nine and the
ecosystem table gives him Jane, Bianca and Catherine. Say the word if a tenth alias
who is not a KRYteria user would be better.

entries.body:
Jane ended it after four dates. Very kindly, very clearly, which I appreciate more than the alternative.

She said there was nothing wrong, which I believe, and that is somehow the part that is hard. I would know what to do with a reason.

I keep trying to fill in what I know about her and I actually know very little. Four dinners. I know she is a lawyer, that she wants children, that she is funny in a dry way that took me two dates to catch. I do not know how she is when something goes wrong, because nothing went wrong in four dinners. I do not know whether she would have planned anything, because I planned all four.

I am not sure what I am supposed to have learned here. I think I have a conclusion that I did not get enough information to support.

entries.body:
Three women in a year, all of them decent, all of them ended it, none of them because of anything I did.

What I notice writing that down is that I planned every single date across all three. Every one. I thought that was being a good person to date. It might also mean I have never once found out whether any of them would have.

I do not know whether the problem is that I am not anyone's type, or that I never let it get far enough to find out. Those would need completely different things from me.
